description: Analyze readable UTF-8 text or manage a private, resumable file-analysis job. Public text URLs are bounded to 1 MiB; pasted text to 60,000 UTF-16 code units and the complete MCP JSON request to 64 KiB. Private files require an active Zambo capability key and stay in private App Storage; use job_action=create, upload_url, upload_complete, part, status, pause, resume, cancel, review, delete or list. Files are limited to 25 MiB; PDFs to 200 pages; ZIPs to 20 MiB compressed, 50 MiB expanded, 100 text entries and 100:1 expansion. PDFs, images, archives and private repositories are not executed. Scanned pages/images require explicit Groq OCR consent, billed to Zambo with no separate user charge; exact provider USD cost is unavailable. Each analysis part covers at most 24,000 UTF-16 code units; file jobs resume after reconnect, lock source revisions, do not advance failed parts, and require complete range reconciliation and owner review. For larger text jobs keep the same _session_id, continue with offset and expected_source_sha256, collect every range and review before synthesizing. Groq fallbacks use the existing provider account, not a paid overflow service. When unavailable, YOU (the connected AI) can analyze the authenticated source range and submit host_analysis with host_handoff_token using this same tool. A pending handoff is not completion and spends no free call; submission is labeled host-AI reported, never independently verified. Use analysis_mode=host_ai to skip Zambo inference entirely. Your AI's own plan still applies. Set require_semantic_analysis:true to retain an error until semantic analysis is submitted. Free: 3 analyses/day in addition to the shared free allowance. An active Day Pass or Zambo Pass removes this tool's daily cap, not its input, file or provider limits. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

_caller_handle.description: Opaque anonymous continuity handle returned during initialize. Reuse it across MCP sessions; it is not payment authorization.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

allow_ocr.description: Explicitly permit sending only scanned pages/image files to Groq for OCR after reviewing the returned provider cost disclosure.

analysis_mode.description: auto tries Groq then delegates to the connected AI. host_ai sends no Zambo inference requests; analyze the returned source excerpt yourself, then submit with this same tool.

content_type.description: Declared MIME type, checked again against extracted content.

decision.description: Owner review decision after all ranges have been reconciled.

email.description: Legacy compatibility field; email alone never establishes paid access. Use the connected pass credential.

expected_source_sha256.description: Previous coverage.source_sha256; required for offset > 0. Stops mixed-revision analyses.

filename.description: Original filename for a private file job.

host_ai_model.description: Your actual model name, or 'not disclosed'. Stored as caller-reported provenance.

host_analysis.description: Your structured analysis of the recorded range: required title, summary and key_points array; optional doc_type, entities, risks, action_items, sentiment, confidence, word_count_estimate, brief. Recorded as caller reported, not independent verification.

host_handoff_token.description: Private recorded range token from host_handoff.token. Never share it in a public receipt or link.

job_action.description: Optional private-file job action. Omit to use bounded text/URL analysis.

job_id.description: Private job ID returned by create.

offset.description: Initially 0. Continue with the exact coverage.next_offset returned by the previous part.

require_semantic_analysis.description: If true, retain an error until semantic analysis is complete. A recorded host-AI handoff can accompany the error; it is not completed analysis.

size.description: File size in bytes; file bytes upload directly to the private upload URL.

text.description: Extracted readable text. Full JSON must fit 64 KiB; use smaller excerpts for multi-byte text. URL takes precedence if both are supplied.

url.description: Public HTTPS UTF-8 text or HTML URL, up to 1 MiB. Not a binary PDF, archive, image or authenticated repository.

name: doc_intel

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.
